author: Nick Crowley
description:
Taking care of your health just got easier – start here with my sponsor Zocdoc: https://Zocdoc.com/nickcrowley

In 2012, grainy cell phone footage leaked online showing a small group of women and men dancing after a wedding. Despite appearing harmless on the surface, many have since claimed that the release of this footage directly caused the deaths of each of the women shown within it, along with several others. In an incident known today as the 2012 Kohistan Video Conspiracy.
